title: EV Database - Volvo XC40 Recharge Twin Motor (MY24)
notes: European 2024 spec page: 82 kWh nominal / 79 usable, NMC 108s1p prismatic, 400 V, Volvo-claimed 205 kW, AC 11 kW, preconditioning (automatic via navigation). The European 2024 Twin got the 82 kWh pack; the US/Canada 2024 Twin kept 78 kWh.
